claims: A failed run capacitor often shows visible bulging or swelling on its outer casing.
You may notice oily or fluid leakage coming from the body of the capacitor.
The top terminal area might be pushed out or distorted.
Burn marks or discoloration on the casing can also indicate failure.

claims.text: A faulty run capacitor often becomes swollen with bowed or bulged sides or ends.
It can be clear that a capacitor has failed if it is swollen or blown apart, causing the electrolyte to leak.
